summary.text: Ted Hill represents Idaho House District 14, Seat A, according to the Idaho Legislature's 2026 membership directory, which lists Eagle as the legislator's city.

paragraphs.text: The directory biography says Hill was born and raised in Idaho and holds a Bachelor of Business Administration from Boise State University and a master's degree in international relations from Salve Regina University.
It says Hill joined the Navy in 1984, served as a fighter pilot and squadron commander, and retired in April 2022 after 38 years of service.
